✨ Fenton Amber Opalescent Hobnail Fairy Lamp ✨

Fenton revived the fairy lamp tradition in the 1950s, and hobnail became one of the company’s signature fairy-light patterns. Their two-piece number 3608 Hobnail Fairy Light was introduced in 1969 and was produced in a variety of colors over the years. 

And that opalescent glow? That’s part of the glass, not something that happened with age. Fenton’s amber/opalescent glassware was produced as a collectible giftware line in the late 1970s–mid-1980s.
